reason: Most of what I buy are cheap little things like makeup, accessories and phone cases, and with 13,000 per kilo plus the 3,000 minimum and 5,000 delivery the fees end up as much as the item. My Instagram page already gets me Shein stuff and I don't even know how to find things on Taobao.
objection: Paying 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 item is too much for me. For small cheap things, the per-kilo shipping and fixed fees make it not worth it.
would_change_my_mind: If I could group lots of small items from different links into one shipment with one delivery fee, and see a cheap total quote for something like 300 grams before I pay.
